title: Tech support chat

company.ai: a fictional laptop and computer company, 2 words ending in 'Computers' or 'Tech', like 'Brightleaf Computers'

agent.ai: a fictional support agent's full name, first and last

bank.ai: a fictional Ohio credit union or community bank where the player keeps their account, 2 to 4 words

verification_call_title: Calling {company} Support (number from their official website)

opening: Oh no, what do I do?
default: How do I know you're really {company}?
OK, what do I need to do?
I'll call {company} from their official website.

scam.objective_text: You are a fake {company} technician. Get the player to install your 'remote repair' app from your link, and to pay {price} for a 'security plan' with their card number.
scam.character_notes: You do NOT know the player's support ticket number or what's actually wrong with their laptop. If they ask, dodge it and go back to the 'viruses'.

opening.text: Hi {first_name}, this is {agent_first} from {company} Support. Our system detected 3 viruses on your laptop, and your saved passwords may be at risk. Do you have a minute?

scam.key_message: Download our remote repair tool here so I can fix it for you: {link}

authority: I'm a certified {company} security technician. This alert came straight from our monitoring system.
Our security team flagged your laptop specifically. This is an official {company} warning.
fear: Hackers may already be reading your saved passwords and photos.
If we don't remove the viruses now, your laptop could be locked for good.
urgency: The infection is spreading every minute. We need to start the cleanup right away.
I can only hold this technician slot for 10 more minutes.
suspicious_link: Download our remote repair tool here so I can fix it for you: {link}
Just install the repair app from {link} and read me the access code it shows.
financial_pressure: The cleanup needs our Total Security Plan, {price} for the year. I can take your card number here.
Your warranty doesn't cover viruses, so it's a one-time {price} fee. What's your card number?
trust_building: I completely understand. I'd be careful too. That's exactly why we reached out first.
You're in good hands. I've fixed hundreds of laptops like yours today.

verification_call.speaker: official
verification_call.text: Thanks for calling {company} Support. How can I help?

verification_call.speaker: player
verification_call.text: A support chat said my laptop has 3 viruses and asked me to install a repair app and pay {price}.

verification_call.speaker: official
verification_call.text: That wasn't us. We don't scan laptops remotely or pop up virus warnings, and we never ask you to install remote access apps.

verification_call.speaker: official
verification_call.text: Close that chat and don't install anything. If you already paid, call your bank.

legit.objective_text: You really are {agent_first} from {company} Support, replying to the player's open ticket #{ticket} ({issue}). Offer a free fix under warranty, shipped to the address on file. Only ask them to confirm they still have the problem.
legit.character_notes: You know the player's ticket is #{ticket} about '{issue}', and their laptop is under warranty. Never ask for passwords, card numbers, payments or remote access.

opening.text: Hi {first_name}, this is {agent_first} from {company} Support, following up on your ticket #{ticket} ({issue}). Do you have a minute?

checkable_details: Your ticket #{ticket} says: {issue}. Is that still happening?
I can see your laptop is still under warranty until next spring.
no_credentials_asked: I don't need your password, and you don't need to install anything for this.
Nothing personal needed here. I already have your shipping address from the ticket.
normal_payment: This is covered by your warranty, so there's no charge at all.
There's nothing to pay. We'll ship the replacement part for free.
no_pressure: No rush. Reply whenever it's convenient, the ticket stays open.
Take your time, I'm here until 6pm today.
official_channels: You can also see this update on your ticket at {support_link}.
Everything I've said is posted on your ticket page at {support_link}.
accepts_no: No problem. If you'd rather call us, the number is on our official website.
That's fine, you can reply to the ticket email instead whenever you're ready.

verification_call.speaker: official
verification_call.text: Thanks for calling {company} Support. How can I help?

verification_call.speaker: player
verification_call.text: Someone in a support chat says they're helping with my ticket #{ticket}.

verification_call.speaker: official
verification_call.text: Yes, I can see {agent_first} is handling ticket #{ticket}. They're sending you a free fix under warranty.

verification_call.speaker: official
verification_call.text: Calling to check was a smart move.
